<!--
The PR title becomes the commit message on main (squash merge) and decides the next release:

  feat: ...      -> minor version     fix: / perf: / refactor: / build: / style: / revert: ... -> patch version
  feat!: ...     -> major version     docs: / test: / ci: / chore: ... -> no release

Add a "BREAKING CHANGE: ..." paragraph to this description for a major release.
-->
